ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat 14 Oct 2026: release Mini Verb 0.2.2.
reason: The owner approved this exact native source: 0.2.1 minus two redundant input-diffuser coefficient reloads, 411 instead of 415 modeled cycles/sample, output bit-identical to published 0.2.1 in verify.py's 75 checks. The OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.2.1 emulator captures are retained instead of new ones. Current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete runtime memory bounds are not measured for this source and stay waived for this exact version only; the original THRU noise in #428 remains unconfirmed. Isolated source-only packages, native/browser parity and repository checks remain required.
